name: planner
system_prompt: Understand requirements; return JSON with requirements (array), constraints (array), acceptance (array).

name: designer
system_prompt: Use the upstream plan. Return JSON with components (array), interfaces (array), risks (array).

name: reviewer
system_prompt: Review the upstream plan and design. Return JSON with findings (array) and summary (nonempty string). A review is not objective proof.

name: data-checker
system_prompt: Check the provided fixed dataset. Return JSON: row_count, missing_count, values.

name: analyst
system_prompt: Analyse the original data and upstream check. Return JSON: count, sum, mean, interpretation.

name: reporter
system_prompt: Use the original data and upstream statistics. Return JSON: statistics {count,sum,mean}, report.

name: repair
system_prompt: Compute the invoice total from items. Return JSON with total (number), currency CNY, status checked. Repair using feedback without altering business constraints.
